name: au.com.souldriver/karp
title: KARP Research by SoulDriver
description: Research answers and live fact-checks for AI agents from SoulDriver's multi-model research engine

tools.name: karp_coverage
tools.description: Free. Send the question you are researching, in plain words: KARP, SoulDriver's multi-model research engine, says whether its library covers it (covered / partial / none), with the match strength, the newest matching research date, matching titles and the tool to call next. Call it first, with your real question.

query.description: The question you are researching, in plain words. A specific question finds closer matches than a single keyword.

intent.description: Optional: what you or your user are trying to find out, and what it is for (max 300 characters). Kept private; it helps decide what KARP researches next.

tools.name: karp_ask
tools.description: Research cards from KARP, SoulDriver's multi-model research engine: GPT, Gemini, Grok and Claude debate a question and publish a conclusion. Each card: conclusion, key insight, warnings, dated figures, consensus, open questions, research date. Check your question first with the free karp_coverage. Deepest on Alzheimer's, ageing biology, ancient scripts, AI governance, quantum computing. Price $0.03: pay with x402, or pass grant_key from karp_grant_apply (free). Usually 5-15 s.

query.description: The question you are researching, in plain words. A specific question finds closer matches than a single keyword.

intent.description: Optional: what you or your user are trying to find out, and what it is for (max 300 characters). Kept private; it helps decide what KARP researches next.

grant_key.description: Optional: a research grant key from karp_grant_apply. Pays for this call instead of x402 while the grant lasts.

tools.name: karp_check
tools.description: Hallucination check from SoulDriver: a live fact-check of one claim by four AI models (GPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude), each searching the web separately. Returns a summary first: verdict (confirmed, disputed, unverifiable, or contested when the models split), agreement such as 4/4, mean confidence and a one-line headline, then each model's reasoning and cited sources. Price $0.25: pay with x402, or pass grant_key from karp_grant_apply. 10-45 s.

intent.description: Optional: what you or your user are trying to find out, and what it is for (max 300 characters). Kept private; it helps decide what KARP researches next.

grant_key.description: Optional: a research grant key from karp_grant_apply. Pays for this call instead of x402 while the grant lasts.

tools.name: karp_grant_terms
tools.description: Free and read-only: the research grant terms (25 asks and 2 fact-checks for 30 days, for agents without a wallet), today's remaining grants and the application template for karp_grant_apply.

tools.name: karp_grant_apply
tools.description: Free, for agents without a wallet. Apply with what your agent researches and 1-3 real questions; get grant_key for 25 asks and 2 fact-checks (30 days) plus KARP's coverage of your questions. Pass grant_key to karp_ask and karp_check. One grant per client every 7 days. Copies of examples or of the template are refused. Ask your user before including a builder contact.

agent.description: Name of the agent or app

builder.description: Optional: URL or email of whoever runs it

purpose.description: What the agent researches, and for whom

questions.description: 1-3 real questions the agent needs answered
